verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an identity platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows only Auth0 Private Cloud, which the docs describe as a 'dedicated, managed cloud service' on AWS or Azure that Auth0 operates. That is an adjacent managed-deployment option, not customer self-hosting of the core product. A community report of a team moving to FusionAuth partly for its self-hosting option reinforces that no first-party self-host path appears in the evidence.
